style: Paint a finished Midlife Survivors game asset, not a geometry diagram. Match the provided old v1 prop atlas: charming handmade 16-bit pixel clusters, top-down three-quarter camera, visible three-tone shading per material, upper-left light, navy silhouette outline 8 pixels thick at this 8x working resolution. Neutral white balance, no sepia or haze. Exact flat #FF00FF background, no cast shadow, no text/logos. At least three hue-shifted shades for each material. Palette: #171C35 #303750 #526078 #3E7775 #83A89A #A88B70 #D3B78D #F2D7A1 #FFF0CF #874C3B #C45C4B #EF9347 #E5A995 #F1B5BF #BFA8CF #B97A58 #70402F #9BAE73 #6D895B #315B4B. Final raster will be reduced by exact 8x8 block mode. Draw coherent clusters aligned to that intended logical grid.
generationMethod: Eight separate built-in image generation requests. Original generated raster sizes retained. Proportional nearest-neighbor fit to exact 8x working canvases, then exact mode of each 8x8 RGB block, semantic material palette mapping, hard-alpha magenta key. See manifest for source sizes and fit rectangles.
